## Build a markdown variable list string from structured variable specs {.unnumbered}


### Description

Takes a list of variable specification lists and produces a markdown
bullet-point string describing each variable (with value labels if present).



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_variable_list(var_list)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="var_list">var_list</code></td>
<td>
A list of lists, each containing:


<dl>
<dt>name</dt><dd>Variable name (character)
</dd>
<dt>label</dt><dd>Variable label (character)
</dd>
<dt>value_labels</dt><dd>Named character/numeric vector of value labels, or NULL
</dd>
</dl>
</td></tr>
</table>


### Value

A single character string with markdown bullet points separated by
newlines.
